tool_args.rationale: Fit the verified siphon base with a signed square-root branch across all seven rows, using the full fallback bounds so a heterogeneous rho is not clipped. Fresh confirmation will test the fitted law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired wide-gradient rows resolve the pilot's parameter collinearity; the stated mechanism is a present-variable law at this horizon.
The observed response is monotone and concave rather than decreasing at high substrate, and the wide-gradient observations support the siphon mechanism.
Observed gradients are below the stated supercritical threshold, and the required high-gradient probe is not in the available menu.
